claims.statement: QQQ uses the current official total expense ratio from the Invesco fund page.
IEMG uses the current official gross expense ratio from the iShares fund page.
SGOV uses the current official gross expense ratio from the iShares fund page.
QQQ historical drawdown is calculated from 10 years of Nasdaq daily closes with cash distributions reinvested.
IEMG historical drawdown is calculated from 10 years of official iShares daily NAV and ex-dividend data.
SGOV historical drawdown is calculated from all official iShares daily NAV and ex-dividend data available since inception.
BMNR historical drawdown is calculated from all Nasdaq daily closing-price data available for the current ticker.
BMNR identity and filing record are sourced from SEC EDGAR.
Macro score inputs use listed FRED series and Treasury data.
Gross CAGR, volatility and relevance values are forecast assumptions, not externally verifiable facts.
Forward P90 drawdown is the 90th percentile of maximum drawdowns from 10,000 deterministic monthly 10-year simulation paths.
Allocation, rate and Monte Carlo result are recomputed daily from the transparent model.
